description: Abstract class for handling file responses and setting headers in the OrangeHRM system, providing methods for creating file responses and configuring HTTP headers for file downloads.

classes.name: AbstractFileController
classes.description: Abstract controller class providing file response handling and HTTP header configuration for file downloads.

methods.name: getNewFileResponse
methods.description: Creates a new BinaryFileResponse object for a given file.

methods.name: getFileResponse
methods.description: Returns a cached BinaryFileResponse object or creates a new one if not already set.

methods.name: makeAttachmentDisposition
methods.description: Generates a Content-Disposition header value for file attachment with proper encoding.

methods.name: setCommonHeadersToResponse
methods.description: Sets common HTTP headers for file download responses, including content type, length, disposition, and cache control.
